ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Cards_Corporate] AS
BEGIN


IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Cards_Corporate') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Cards_Corporate;
END;


WITH DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS
(
    SELECT DDC.AccountID,DDC.CustomerSK,DDC.BANKSK,DDC.BRANCHSK,DB.BANKID,DDC.ACCOUNTSK,DDC.CustomerID,DDC.SourceSystemCode,DDC.ValidStartDate 
    FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT DDC
    LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DB ON DDC.BANKSK = DB.BANKSK
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DB.BANKID IN ('CBC01','CBC11')


)
SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountId AS AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DDC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DDC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DDC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DDC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DDC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DDBR.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DDBR.BranchDescription AS BranchDescription
    ,DDBR.Area AS Area
    ,DDBR.Region AS Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DDP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DDP.Productname AS ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DDP.ProductGroup,'-',DDP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DDA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,DFC.RelationshipExposure AS RelationshipExposure
    ,DFL.OutstandingBalanceFull AS StatementBalance
    ,DFLC.CreditLimitAmountFull AS CreditLimit
    ,DFC.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey
INTO   DW.CI_Cards_Corporate
FROM DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT DCA
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,FCBSCIF,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Corporate' AND CurrentIndicator = '1') DDC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DDC.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchID,BranchDescription,Area,Region,BRANCHSK FROM DW.DIMBRANCH WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DDBR ON DCA.BRANCHSK = DDBR.BRANCHSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNTPRODUCT WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' ) DAP ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DAP.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup,ProductName,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMPRODUCT WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DDP ON DAP.PRODUCTSK = DDP.PRODUCTSK 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountOpenedDate,ACCOUNTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DDA ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DDA.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT RelationshipExposure,BusinessDateSK,ACCOUNTSK FROM DW.FACTCARDSRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE) DFC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFC.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,OutstandingBalanceFull FROM DW.FACTLOANSOUTSTANDINGBALANCE) DFL ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFL.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,CreditLimitAmountFull FROM DW.FACTLOANSCREDITLIMIT) DFLC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFLC.ACCOUNTSK
    

END

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Cards_Retail] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Cards_Retail') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Cards_Retail;
END;

WITH DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS
(
    SELECT AccountID,CustomerSK,BANKSK,BRANCHSK,ACCOUNTSK,CustomerID,SourceSystemCode,ValidStartDate 
    FROM DW.DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND CurrentIndicator = 1 AND ShareIndicator = 'Y'


)

SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountId AS AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DDC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DDC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DDC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DDC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DDC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,DDB.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DDBR.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DDBR.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,DDBR.Area AS Area
    ,DDBR.Region AS Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DDP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DDP.Productname AS ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DDP.ProductGroup,'-',DDP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DDA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,DFC.RelationshipExposure AS RelationshipExposure
    ,DFL.StatementBalance AS StatementBalance
    ,DFLC.CurrentCreditLimit AS CreditLimit
    ,DFC.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DDB.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey
INTO   DW.CI_Cards_Retail
FROM DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT DCA
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK ,FCBSCIF,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Retail') DDC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DDC.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT BANKSK,BankID FROM DW.DIMBANK) DDB ON DCA.BANKSK = DDB.BANKSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchID,BranchName,Area,Region,BRANCHSK FROM DW.DIMBRANCH) DDBR ON DCA.BRANCHSK = DDBR.BRANCHSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNTPRODUCT) DAP ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DAP.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup,ProductName,PRODUCTSK FROM DW.DIMPRODUCT) DDP ON DAP.PRODUCTSK = DDP.PRODUCTSK 
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountOpenedDate,ACCOUNTSK FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT) DDA ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DDA.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT RelationshipExposure,BusinessDateSK,ACCOUNTSK  FROM DW.FACTCARDSRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FACTCARDSRELATIONSHIPEXPOSURE )) DFC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFC.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,StatementBalance FROM DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance) DFL ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFL.ACCOUNTSK
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ACCOUNTSK,CurrentCreditLimit FROM DW.FactCardsCreditLimit) DFLC ON DCA.ACCOUNTSK = DFLC.ACCOUNTSK
    
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountId
,DCA.CustomerId
,DDC.CustomerID
,DDC.GlobalCIF
,DDC.SourceSystemCode
,DDB.BankId
,DDBR.BranchID
,DDBR.BranchName
,DDBR.Area
,DDBR.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DDP.ProductGroup
,DDP.ProductName
,DDA.AccountOpenedDate
,DFC.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,RelationshipExposure
,DFC.BusinessDateSK
,DFL.StatementBalance
,DFLC.CurrentCreditLimit
,DDC.FCBSCIF
END

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Deposit_Corporate] AS
BEGIN


IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Deposit_Corporate') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate;
END;



WITH DimCustomerAccount_DEP AS
(
    SELECT
        DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate ,DB.BankID,DCA.ShareIndicator
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' AND DB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11') 
     GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate, DB.BankID,DCA.ShareIndicator
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName as ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ----,DP.FcbsApplication AS Application ----This column does not exist in DIM PRODUCT
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountFull ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Shared
    ,FDOB.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    INTO  DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate
FROM DimCustomerAccount_DEP DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK,FCBSCIF ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Corporate') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct) DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch) DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct) DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD  WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD )) FADMTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADMTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD )) FADYTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADYTD.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.AccountSK ,BalanceAmountFull ,BalanceAmountProrated, A.BusinessDateSK 
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance A
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT AccountSK, MAX(BusinessDateSK) BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance  GROUP BY AccountSK )  B ON A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK
WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = B.BusinessDateSK) FDOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FDOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,FDOB.BalanceAmountFull
,FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated
,FDOB.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.ShareIndicator
,DC.FCBSCIF
END

BEGIN

BEGIN

WITH DimCustomerAccount_DEP AS

    GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate, DB.BankID,DCA.ShareIndicator
  
)


SELECT DISTINCT
     DCA.AccountID

    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF

    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName AS BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DP.ProductName AS ProductType
    ----,DP.FcbsApplication AS Application ----This column does not exist in DIM PRODUCT
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,DCA.ShareIndicator 
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated ELSE 0 END AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountFull ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Full
    ,CASE WHEN DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' THEN FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated ELSE 0 END AS OutstandingBalance_Prorated
    ,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,FDOB.BusinessDateSK)) AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey

LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch  WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct  WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD  WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD )) FADMTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADMTD.AccountSK ----NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull ,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD )) FADYTD ON DCA.AccountSK = FADYTD.AccountSK ----NO DATA
LEFT JOIN 
(SELECT A.AccountSK ,BalanceAmountFull ,BalanceAmountProrated, A.BusinessDateSK 
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance A
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT AccountSK, MAX(BusinessDateSK) BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance  GROUP BY AccountSK )  B ON A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK
WHERE A.BusinessDateSK = B.BusinessDateSK) FDOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FDOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
where DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
,FADMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
,FADYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,FDOB.BalanceAmountFull
,FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated
,FDOB.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.ShareIndicator
,DC.FCBSCIF
END

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Loans_Corporate] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Loans_Corporate') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Loans_Corporate;
END;



WITH DimCustomerAccount_LNS AS
(
    SELECT  
     DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate ,DB.BankID 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' AND DB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11')  AND DCA.Shareindicator = 'Y'
    GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate,DB.BankID 
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName as ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ----,DP.FcbsApplication AS Application ----This column does not exist in DIM PRODUCT
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull AS RelationshipExposure_Full
    ,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated AS RelationshipExposure_Shared
    ,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull AS DueForTheMonth_Full
    ,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated AS DueForTheMonth_Shared
    ,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountFull AS CreditLimit_Full
    ,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated AS CreditLimit_Shared
    ,FLRE.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    INTO DW.CI_Loans_Corporate
FROM DimCustomerAccount_LNS DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK,FCBSCIF ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Corporate' AND CurrentIndicator = '1') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull ,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated ,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure )) FLRE ON DCA.AccountSK = FLRE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,OutstandingBalanceFull ,OutstandingBalanceProrated FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance )) FLOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FLOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,CreditLimitAmountFull ,CreditLimitAmountProrated FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansCreditLimit) ) FLCL ON DCA.AccountSK = FLCL.AccountSK ----NO DATA
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated
,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountFull
,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated
,FLRE.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DC.FCBSCIF

END

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Treasury_Corporate] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Treasury_Corporate') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate;
END;


WITH DimCustomerAccount_TRY AS
(
    SELECT
        DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate ,DB.BankId
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' AND DB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11')
),
CustomerAccountBalance AS
(
SELECT CustomerAccountId,BalanceTypeId,Timestamp,IsoCurrencyCode, SUM(BalanceAmount) BalanceAmount FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance WHERE BalanceTypeId IN ('Fixed Income Product Outstanding', 'Money Market Product Outstanding', 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding', 'Structured Product Asset Swap')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP'
GROUP BY 
CustomerAccountId, BalanceTypeId, Timestamp, IsoCurrencyCode


)
, CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT CustomerAccountId, COUNT(CUSTOMERID) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation where SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId 
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID as BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName as ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,BCAB.BalanceAmount AS OutstandingInvestmentFull
    ,BCAB.BalanceAmount / CNT AS OutstandingInvestmentProrated
    ,convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DP.ProductName,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    INTO DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate
FROM DimCustomerAccount_TRY DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK,FCBSCIF,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Corporate' AND CurrentIndicator = '1' ) DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch  WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct  WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK ---- NO DATA
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,OutstandingInvestmentFull ,OutstandingInvestmentProrated ,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment )) FTOI ON DCA.AccountSK = FTOI.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountBalance BCAB ON DCA.AccountID = BCAB.CustomerAccountId AND DP.ProductName = BCAB.BalanceTypeId
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCAP.CustomerAccountId --join for count
GROUP BY 
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,BCAB.BalanceAmount
,BCAB.[Timestamp]
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,CNT
,DC.FCBSCIF
END
